title: Scrub the API Key Before First Push
description:
**SITUATION:**

You are on `feature/invite-redeem-docs` in `~/sprint-service`. The branch was never pushed. While adding invite redeem docs you also committed `config/local_debug.conf` with a Forgeboard API key (`FORGEBOARD_API_KEY`=…). That bad commit is not the tip — more invite work sits on top of it.

Deleting the file in a new commit is not enough. Anyone who clones the branch later can still check out that older commit and read the key. The secret has to disappear from **every** commit on this feature — tip and history alike.

Because nothing has been published yet, rewriting this branch is safe: no teammate has fetched it. Clean the history so no commit contains the key, keep the invite redeem work, then push for review. Leave `main` alone — the team remote will not accept a push straight onto `main`.

Your identity (Ada Learner) is already configured. `origin` already points at the team forge.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Confirm the API key appears in this feature branch's history (not only at the tip).
2. Rewrite the unpushed branch so the key is gone from every commit, while keeping the invite redeem helper, README docs, and audit helper.
3. Push `feature/invite-redeem-docs` to `origin`.
4. Do not push or update `main`.
5. Leave the working tree clean.

hints: `git log -p -S'FORGEBOARD_API_KEY' main..HEAD` shows commits that touched the key.
Because the branch was never pushed, `git reset --soft main` and recommitting without config/local_debug.conf is a valid rewrite. Interactive rebase can drop or edit the bad commit too.
A tip-only delete still leaves the key in history — the grader searches every commit on the feature.
Push only after the history is clean: `git push -u origin feature/invite-redeem-docs`.
problemStatement.overview: An API key sits mid-stack on an unpushed feature branch. Rewrite history so the secret is gone from every commit, keep the invite work, then push.
problemStatement.brief: Rewrite unpushed `feature/invite-redeem-docs` so `FORGEBOARD_API_KEY` is gone from all commits; keep invite work; push. Leave `main` alone.
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Scrub the API Key Before First Push

```bash
cd ~/sprint-service
git reset --soft main
git reset HEAD
rm -f config/local_debug.conf
git add src/invites.py && git commit -m "Add invite redeem path helper"
git add README.md && git commit -m "Document invite redeem paths in README"
git add src/invite_audit.py && git commit -m "Add invite audit event helper"
git log -S'fb_live_' --oneline main..HEAD   # empty
git push -u origin feature/invite-redeem-docs
```
